vendor.ask: Which acquisition software imports the file?
vendor.help: masslynx = Waters MassLynx 4.x sample list (.csv), sciexos = SCIEX OS batch (.txt), masshunter = Agilent MassHunter Acquisition worklist (.csv), xcalibur = Thermo Xcalibur sequence (.csv).

output_dir.ask: Folder where worklist files are written (a folder the acquisition PC can open)
output_dir.help: Local to the acquisition PC, or a share it reads. The package only needs write access; the person importing needs read access from the vendor software.

tune_file.ask: MassLynx MS tune file name (MS_TUNE_FILE column), blank for none

data_path.ask: Xcalibur data folder written to the Path column, blank for the sequence default

bracket_type.ask: Xcalibur bracket type (1 Overlapped, 2 None, 3 Non-Overlapped, 4 Open)

list_separator.ask: Xcalibur list separator: ',' or ';' (must equal the Windows list separator on the acquisition PC)

max_rows.ask: Most rows one worklist may carry
